title: The Photographer Who Defines the House
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Photographer Who Defines the House: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A photographer can make a house recognizable by translating garments into light, time, body, setting, and repeatable image grammar; that cultural power does not collapse authorship, copyright ownership, commission terms, credit, or archive custody into one answer.

frames.caption: 01 · GRAMMAR — What makes the image-world recognizable?. Trace light, distance, movement, lens position, setting, casting, color, sequencing, and refusal across a defined body of work. Describe patterns without claiming the house or photographer owns an abstract style.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what makes the image-world recognizable? within The Photographer Who Defines the House.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · AUTHOR — Who created the photograph?. Preserve photographer, assistants, digital technician, set, styling, model, hair, makeup, retouching, and commissioner records. Under U.S. guidance, do not assume a commission alone answers work-made-for-hire status.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who created the photograph? within The Photographer Who Defines the House.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · LICENSE — What may the house actually do?. Attach usage media, territory, term, exclusivity, crops, derivatives, credits, embargoes, archive copies, portfolio uses, and approval language. Route ownership and transfer questions to counsel with the executed agreement.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what may the house actually do? within The Photographer Who Defines the House.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · MEMORY — Whose archive preserves the house image?. Map negatives or RAW files, selects, contact sheets, captions, model releases, licenses, expiry, publication proofs, and preservation custody. Cultural memory may depend on a record the house does not own.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

frames.caption: The phrase “photographer who defines the house” risks overstating one maker and understating the designer, stylist, model, art director, set, retoucher, publication, and audience. Use it as a question about sustained image grammar, never as automatic sole-credit or ownership language.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Photographer Who Defines the House.
